items.headline: OpenAI cuts funding target by $10B to ~$20B, valuation set at $1.25T amid tech selloff
items.why: Signals investor pushback on AI valuations even as largest private AI financing proceeds

items.headline: PBOC shifts policy-rate anchor to overnight repo rate, discloses it at 1.25%
items.why: Structural change to China's rate-setting framework, a signal of scope for further easing that matters for China growth and risk appetite

items.headline: DeepSeek closes ~$16B funding round (~105.5B yuan) at ~$74B pre-money valuation; Tencent, Alibaba vie for stakes
items.why: Largest Chinese AI-lab raise to date; signals state/strategic capital backing China's frontier-model challenger to US labs

items.headline: Samsung says its 2027 HBM memory supply is already sold out
items.why: Confirms HBM scarcity extending another year, supporting pricing power for memory makers feeding AI chip demand

items.headline: ECB holds deposit rate at 2.50% as eurozone inflation hits 3.8%
items.why: Signals ECB tightening bias into Dec; higher-for-longer EU rates pressure growth-stock multiples incl. AI names

items.headline: SK Hynix starts HBM4 mass production, says DRAM/HBM sold out through 2029
items.why: Extends memory shortage runway, key input cost/availability signal for Nvidia, AMD and AI server makers

items.headline: Fed holds rates at 3.75%-4%; two governors (Cook, Hammack) dissent in favor of a hike
items.why: Split vote raises odds of a December hike, tightening the backdrop for rate-sensitive AI capex financing

items.headline: PBOC injects record ~1 trillion yuan overnight liquidity, plus 700bn yuan MLF operation
items.why: Aggressive China liquidity easing supports China AI-equity complex (Alibaba, Tencent) and risk appetite

items.headline: Nvidia to invest $3B and AMD $1B into Meta's $95B equity offering for AI infrastructure
items.why: Chipmakers taking equity stakes in their biggest customer tightens circular AI financing ties investors are watching

items.headline: AMD secures $20B+ commitment from Anthropic for MI450-based Helios AI systems, deliveries from 2027
items.why: Major proof point for AMD as a credible Nvidia alternative in frontier AI training/inference compute

items.headline: SpaceX secures $40B debt financing for GPU leasing; Meta seeks $95B AI infra financing — ~$235B single-day AI deal blitz
items.why: Scale of one-day AI infrastructure financing underscores how debt-funded the capex buildout has become

items.headline: Anthropic files S-1 for IPO, discloses plans to spend up to $567B on compute and $80B in H1 losses
items.why: First full look at Anthropic's compute cost structure and cash burn ahead of what could be a record IPO

items.headline: Anthropic publicly files S-1 for Nasdaq IPO (ticker ANT), targeting up to $2T valuation, listing eyed for Nov 12
items.why: Would be the largest-ever AI IPO and a key valuation benchmark for the whole private AI-lab cohort

items.headline: BofA, Blackstone, Citigroup and Morgan Stanley arrange $63B financing for Anthropic to lease Broadcom AI chips
items.why: Large non-bank/bank syndicate financing of custom AI accelerators shows how AI infra debt is being structured
